title.zh: 三星泰勒1号晶圆厂启动后续设备投资，冲刺2纳米量产
title.en: 三星泰勒1号晶圆厂启动后续设备投资，冲刺2纳米量产

current_state.zh: Samsung began follow-on equipment investment at its Taylor, Texas Fab 1, ordering tools for an initial ~6,000 wafers per month as it targets 20,000 wpm of 2nm capacity by late 2027, backed by full 2nm orders from Tesla, Broadcom, and Arm.
